_comment: Template for server/private/viewers.json, which is gitignored because it
holds real client email addresses. Copy this file to
server/private/viewers.json on the server and edit it by hand.
Each key is the URL slug: an entry is served at
https://www.liveuo.com/viewer/<key>/
title    shown in the header and in the OTP email
file     inside server/private/. Never served statically; only ever
streamed to a verified session. The extension picks the kind:
.pdf          document, rendered page by page
.mp4          video
.m3u8         HLS video; its segments sit in the same folder
(npm run demos:encode makes these)
library  instead of file: a folder of HLS videos played by a page
elsewhere on the site. pharcare-demo gates the pharCare demo
page at /products/pharcare/demo/ - no entry, no one can watch.
allow    exact email addresses permitted. Case-insensitive.
There is no wildcard or domain match, deliberately.
expires  YYYY-MM-DD. After this date the entry behaves exactly
as though it does not exist.
Only addresses in allow ever receive a code; anyone else gets the same
on-screen reply and no email, so the list cannot be guessed at.
Changes take effect immediately; no restart is needed.
Delete this _comment key in the real file.
